summary: No single fault fires the e-match with the bus disabled. With the bus enabled the recorded single faults still fire (OUT to GND 0.1768 / 0.1795 mm, Q124 gate to drain 0.5195 mm in the package, a failed-short Q124, the 3V3 via 0.676 mm from R128.1, FMEA I-5, C128); round 21 added no neighbour to any pyro or arming net except fail-safe GND / RAW_PROTECTED / BAT_FAULT_N copper at the moved R81 and C87. D-R21-01, -02, -04 and -05 measure as claimed. S-8 holds at every protected barrel (least 1.0209 mm, native and fabricated Gerber). EN reaches R81 through 4 single items (1 via + 3 segments, 3.890 mm; 13 before); every other copper open leaves EN on R81. One Minor: the owner deviation list section 1 was not carried to 5516eeec.

rejected_or_closed_candidates.candidate: U9 bypass, BAT_IN to RAW_PROTECTED (J1.1 In2 ring 0.2501 mm, BAT_IN via (17.5,87.3) In2 wall 0.2505 mm, U9.5-U9.6 and the B.Cu IN / OUT runs 0.200 mm): board on with J400 open
rejected_or_closed_candidates.disposition: Agree with rounds 20 and 21: running the logic needs a hard short carrying the board current; the bare-board E-test screens fabricated inner shorts and the per-flight off check a present one; a resistive leak cannot run the logic. Unchanged (Gerber and native).

EN floats with C87 and the top: with J400 open it stays where it was; after a closed-switch check opening J400 leaves EN on C87 (at most 0.1 uA leakage: >= about 16 s, or indefinitely), so the board stays on; caught by the per-flight "opening J400 turns it off" check. With J400 closed EN rises toward BAT_IN through 940 kohm, above 6.5 V but at <= 9 uA, which SLVSFC9C p8 note 2 permits (>= 350 kohm pull-up for supplies above 5 V). Part-level; unchanged by D-R21-05.

Two 0.3 mm F.Cu segments, (15.3,56.395)-(15.3,55.395) 1.0 mm and (15.3,55.395)-(16.0,55.395) 0.7 mm, carry the whole gate network (R126 / R127, R128, C126); with the bus enabled a floating gate is undefined (Inference). Inherent under the no-loop routing rule; closed as in rounds 19-20. No via in any gate-to-pull-down path (Q120 / Q121 / Q122 / Q124).

Not worse (not filed, brief). D-R21-02 adds one 3V3 adjacency, 0.475 mm from U2.2 (VLOGIC), not below the existing minima: U2.1-U2.2 pin pair 0.400 mm (B.Cu; U2 EN tied to VLOGIC), In2 plane edges 0.300 mm, J440.1 / J9.1 rings 0.2501 mm. For the record the route list also omits barrel walls at 0.2505 mm: VLOGIC vias (29.8,81.15) and (34.5,63.0) and the CAM_5V via (34.2,49.325) in the In2 3V3 fill, and the 3V3 via (26.4,79.26) in In2 RAW_PROTECTED (all unchanged since 0dc84776). Respin note: Diodes DS41326 Rev 3-2 p2 allows U2 EN to be left open ("Attach to VIN or leave open for automatic startup"), which would remove the U2.1-U2.2 route; the H-9 clamp covers every route.

Not worse. C128 is Murata GCJ188R71H104KA12D, a GCJ soft-termination part (resin external electrodes: "Cracking of the ceramic element is suppressed by the resin of the external electrodes, which releases the stress", Murata GCJ series page). That mitigates the recorded flex-crack short (Inference); the record could say so.

Installed ESD is unqualified (M3_R10). Not filed.
